GHSA-w8wr-v893-vjvp.title: node-tar: Process crash via PAX numeric path type confusion
GHSA-w8wr-v893-vjvp.why: apps/cms is Directus 12.3.1 — one dependency we chose, and a tree of ~1500 we did not. It is a local editing tool: it appears in no workflow, is deployed nowhere, and the public site reads from our own API, never from Directus. Hardlink path traversal and decompression DoS in node-tar. Reached only where an archive is extracted: node-gyp at install time on our own machine, and Directus when an extension is installed — we install none. No fix exists at any version: @directus/api pins tar 7.5.8 exactly, Directus 12.3.1 is the newest release, and an npm `overrides` entry is silently ignored in this tree (verified on 22.09.2026 — overriding tar to a version that does not exist still exits 0 and changes nothing, and forcing the lockfile to re-resolve strips integrity hashes from 2019 of 2022 entries).
